name: UI：模版包管理-置为闲置/立即使用按钮验证
description: 验证模版包卡片操作按钮：使用中→置为闲置，闲置中→立即使用

steps.expression: (() => { const detailBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => b.textContent.trim() === '查看详情'); if(detailBtns.length > 2) { detailBtns[2].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no btn'; })()

(() => { const idleBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => b.textContent.includes('置为闲置')); const useBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => b.textContent.includes('立即使用')); return { hasIdleBtn: idleBtns.length > 0, hasUseBtn: useBtns.length > 0, idleCount: idleBtns.length, useCount: useBtns.length }; })()

steps.label: tmgmt-idle-use-btn
